caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sofa with elaborate detailing. The frame of the sofa is a rich brown color, and the legs feature ornate carvings resembling animal claws and scrollwork. The backrest and seat are upholstered in a dark, possibly navy or black fabric, bordered by gold trim. Both ends of the sofa curve outward and terminate in rolled arms with decorative circular accents, also bordered in gold. The background is a plain, off-white color with scattered brownish stains around the edges. Text on the lower left identifies the sofa as "SOFA DUNCAN PHYFE" and on the lower right is the name "ELIZABETH CURTIS."
title: Sofa
